    from collections import Counter
    frequencies = Counter(all_counts)
    # Mark compartments whose count is the least common count.
    least = min(frequencies.values())
    return [[int(frequencies[x] == least) for x in row] for row in counts]

    div_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
